meta.title: ZZZ Companion — Previously on New Eridu
meta.description: A spoiler-safe Zenless Zone Zero story recap that stops exactly where you are.

progress.title: Where are you?
progress.description: Pick the last part you finished. Only expand the chapter you're on — episode names further ahead can be spoilers.

home.title: New Eridu
home.lede: Forgot what happened? Get a spoiler-safe recap of Zenless Zone Zero that stops exactly where you are in the story.
home.step1: Pick the last part you finished.
home.step2: Read it short or in full.
home.step3: Characters and terms unlock as you go.
home.coverage: Covers the story from the Prologue to the Chapter 2 Interlude (v{version}).
home.manifesto: We kept notes. Every episode, up to the exact part you finished. Not one scene further.
home.step1Body: Everything after it stays locked, everywhere in the app.
home.step2Body: A two-minute catch-up before you play, or the whole story with every detail.
home.step3Body: Names you’ve met become tappable, and character files fill in as the story moves on.
home.rosterTitle: Every Agent you own. One roster.
home.rosterBody: Tap the Agents you’ve pulled and set their Mindscape. Rotations, builds and pull advice will start from this list, kept on this device or synced to an account.
home.outroTitle: Pick up right where you left off.
home.nextBody: In production. They’ll build on your recap and your roster.
home.statusEmpty: Tell us where you are and the recap will stop right there.

recap.title: Your story so far
recap.emptyBody: Set your progress and the recap will appear here — nothing past that point, ever.
recap.partialHint: Sources for this part have less detail, so this summary is shorter.
recap.endBody: That's everything up to your progress. Keep playing and come back for the next part.
recap.lede: Everything up to the last part you finished.
recap.ledeTap: Tap an underlined name or a face for a quick reminder.

characters.title: Characters
characters.lede: Everyone you've met so far, described only with what you already know.
characters.locked: {count, plural, one {# more character appears} other {# more characters appear}} later in the story.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.lede: The terms of New Eridu, unlocked as the story introduces them.
glossary.locked: {count, plural, one {# more term unlocks} other {# more terms unlock}} as you progress.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataHint: Story progress and settings are stored only in this browser. Your Agents too, unless you sign in; then they sync to your account. No tracking.
settings.aboutBody: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with HoYoverse. Story summaries were written for this app after reading the community wiki's transcripts.
settings.accountGuest: Not signed in. Your Agents are saved in this browser.
settings.accountGuestCta: Sign in or create an account

characterFile.metaDescription: A spoiler-safe character file: only what you already know about them.
characterFile.sharedParts: {count, plural, one {# part together} other {# parts together}}
characterFile.lockedBody: This file opens when the story gets there. For now, nothing in it is part of your progress.
characterFile.lockedNoProgress: Set your progress first — files only show what you already know.
characterFile.buildBody: Recommended W-Engines, Drive Discs, stats and skill priority for {name} are on the way.

agents.title: My Agents
agents.metaDescription: Mark the Zenless Zone Zero Agents you own and their Mindscape — the base for rotations, builds and pull advice.
agents.lede: Mark the Agents you have and their Mindscape. Rotations, builds and pull advice will use this list when they arrive.
agents.hint: Tap every Agent you have. That’s it. Set Mindscape with the M button below each one. Have all the A-Ranks? Filter by A-Rank and use Mark all.
agents.showResults: {count, plural, =0 {No Agents} one {Show # Agent} other {Show # Agents}}
agents.resultsLive: {count, plural, =0 {No Agents shown} one {# Agent shown} other {# Agents shown}}
agents.gridLabel: Agents. Check the ones you have.
agents.markAllSr: mark the {count} shown Agents as owned
agents.markedLive: {count, plural, one {# Agent marked as owned.} other {# Agents marked as owned.}}
agents.undoSr: Undo: unmark the {count} Agents just marked
agents.mindscapeHint: M0 is the Agent with no extra copies. Each extra copy adds a level, up to M6.
agents.revealBody: Their name and art come from story this app doesn’t cover yet.
agents.emptyOwnedBody: Switch to All and tap the ones you have.
agents.nudgeBody: Right now they live only in this browser. A free account keeps them on any device. No emails, no tracking.
agents.merged: {count, plural, =0 {Signed in. Your saved Agents are loaded.} one {Signed in. # Agent from this browser was added to your account.} other {Signed in. # Agents from this browser were added to your account.}}
agents.mergedRule: When both had the same Agent, the higher Mindscape was kept.
agents.emptyQueryBody: Nothing matches “{query}”. Check the spelling; English names work too.

sync.localBody: Your Agents are stored in this browser only. Clearing site data or switching devices means starting over. An account keeps them everywhere.
sync.localOff: Accounts aren’t available on this copy of the site.
sync.loadingBody: Getting the Agents saved in your account.
sync.errorBody: Your changes are safe on this device. We’ll keep trying, or you can try now.
sync.offlineBody: Changes are saved on this device and sync when you’re back.
sync.expiredBody: Sign in again to sync. Your changes stay on this device until then.
sync.errorLive: Couldn’t save to your account. Changes kept on this device.

account.title: Account
account.lede: Optional. Sign in to keep your Agents on any device. Everything else works without it.
account.mode: Sign in or create an account
account.name: Proxy name
account.nameHint: How the app greets you. Up to 32 characters.
account.noResetCreate: No email check and no password reset yet. If you forget this password, you’ll need a new account, so keep it in a password manager.
account.noResetSignIn: Forgot your password? There’s no reset yet, sorry. Your Agents on this device aren’t affected.
account.why2: Ready for rotations, builds and pull advice when they arrive
account.why3: No ads, no tracking, no emails
account.storeBody: Your email, Proxy name, a hashed password (never plain text) and your Agents list. Story progress stays in your browser. Delete it all any time.

errors.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email. Check for typos.
errors.wrongCredentials: That email and password don’t match. Check both and try again.
errors.emailTaken: There’s already an account with this email.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the account server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

account.signOutBody: Signing out removes your Agents from this browser. They stay safe in your account.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Your Agents are safe in your account.
account.unsyncedBody: Some changes haven’t reached your account yet. If you sign out now, they’re lost.
account.dangerBody: Deletes your account and the Agents saved in it, for good. Your story progress in this browser stays.
account.deleteBody: This removes {email}, your Proxy name and your saved Agents from our server. It can’t be undone.
account.deleted: Account deleted. Your Agents were removed from this browser too.
account.offBody: This copy of ZZZ Companion has no account server. Everything else works, and your Agents are saved in this browser.
account.downBody: The account server isn’t answering right now. You can still try, or come back later. Nothing on this device is lost.
account.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
